logp.method_description: The log P value of 2a-3c was determined using the shake-flask method and UV-Vis spectroscopy. The octanol used in this experiment was pre-saturated with water. An aqueous solution of 2a-3c (500 μL, 100 μM) was incubated with pre-saturated octanol (500 μL) in a 1.5 mL tube. The tube was shook at room temperature for 48 h. The two phases were separated by centrifugation and 2a-3c content in each phase was determined by UV-Vis spectroscopy.
